title.narrative: ImpactAssets Inc - Collaborative for Frontier Finance - Grant

description.narrative: The mandate of the program is as follows: 1) To be relevant and contextual to ALCPs and their needs – tapping peer knowledge and support 2) Build upon what is available in the market 3) Apply the most replicable, and transfer the knowledge onto CFF/IFC’s joint Fund Manager Portal 4) And, to further support the broader ecosystem, where third party services are required, seek to apply local Africa-based tools/providers

The overall objective of the Capacity Support Program is to provide the Nyala ALCPs with the necessary support to strengthen their capabilities and operation to attract additional investment capital from institutional investors successfully.
The support will be provided through a cost-effective combination. of peer-to-peer engagement, access to digital resources, accelerated learning modules and focused coaching and training.

sector.narrative: In support of Alternative Local Capital Partners (ALCPs)
